build_furniture_database: build a FurnitureDatabase from a CSV metadata path to query furniture assets via SQL
read_furniture_metadata: read furniture metadata from a CSV file and return a dictionary keyed by asset id
sort_eval_metrics: sort evaluation metrics dictionary by mean relative increase across perplexity, action_accuracy, and action_attribute
get_intents: get speaker intents from NLU/NLG annotation in a round datum using USER or ASSISTANT speaker key
get_object_references: extract local object references from turn labels and resolve them to global furniture ids via coref map
